title: Bonus Stage
html: The Bonus Stage can be reached by killing the Gnome Gatekeeper. He is known to have appeared on Widower's Nest Level 1 and 2 and Doug's Digsite and possibly elsewhere. The dungeon consists of a tiny field where two gnomes whizz about. One of them drops health potions when hit, the other drops mana potions. Both Major and Minor Potions seem to be dropped. In a not-defined period of time the player has to whack the gnomes to get potions.
